<div class="card-body">
'''Tactical Re-Call''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">戦術用通信</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どこかで戦闘に勝利した直後に、任意のヤヴィン４の位置カードに配備する。戦闘に参加した戦士を１名対象として選ぶ。対象の戦闘力と没収値は、－２（レイアなら－３）される。その対象がこのカードの位置までたどり着けば、ウーティーニー・エフェクトはキャンセルされる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-231o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">絶滅したマサッシ族の遺跡には、高性能の通信装置が隠されている。この装置により、反乱軍の統制が行われ、士官たちに状況が報告される。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Tactical Communications.

'''Card text:''' Immediately after winning a battle, deploy at any Yavin 4 site. Target one warrior who participated. The target is power and forfeit −2, or −3 if Leia. If the target reaches this card's site, the Utinni Effect is canceled.

'''Lore:''' High-performance communications equipment is hidden in the ruins of the extinct Massassi. The Rebels use it to coordinate operations and report the situation to their officers.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Tactical Re-Call]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
